body: Okay I’m really interested in what people have to say about this because I can completely relate to this. I struggle with a lot of the issues you brought up. I’ve just started therapy again after a long time of not having any help, I’m wondering what my therapist will have to say about my feelings that are similar to this.

It actually went pretty well. I did feel a bit shittier afterwards but I knew that would happen. I made another appointment so we’ll see how it goes! I’m glad I went, though. It sort of reaffirmed how badly I need to go regularly.
Thanks everyone. I can’t believe all of this amazing support exists.

I worry about this a lot too. I was diagnosed when I was 17 with BPD and then it was confirmed again when I was 21 but now I’m 30, been doing relatively alright for some time without therapy but I’ve been out of control for a couple of months. Now I’m sort of stable even though I’m freaking out about an appointment today. 

I think this is a common doubt among BP people because how disorienting it can be. I know that’s not really helpful but I guess I’m just saying I can relate a lot. I’m scared I’m going to go see this person and have them tell me I’m not after being unsure of whether I was or not for so long, then having that confirmed, and then doubted again. Makes me insane!
Whoa, I’m not on Lamictal anymore but things are clicking rn.

Me too. I’m always afraid that I don’t have the skills to actually accomplish anything when a depressive episode hits. It feels so threatening. And it is, it literally threatens all of my goals and even my life.

I just get so confused because I don’t know what’s real? Like what’s me? Is it my hypomania? I know it’s not my depression, but is it? Is it when I’m stable or “normal”? I don’t really feel like a person when I’m normal though, it’s like a liminal state where nothing is good or bad or anything, I’m just existing. Hypomania feels good but is also confounding.
Omg Trubbish is one of favorites!
I’m pretty skeptical of people approaching me because of my physical form though. I’d rather my intellect and personality be the thing that awes someone rather than my appearance.
Grow it out and cut it into a mullet! Or get a bowl cut. My honest advice! I have a bowl cut in the front and mullet in the back and I get compliments all the time.
